column2: 2800L Euro:Septic Tank
column17: The Euro-Septic offers significant technical improvements and cost-savings over current market options. The range, available in capacities from 2800-4500L is CE marked to comply with the Construction Project Regulations and compliments Marsh’s existing range of horizontal Septic Tanks. Tested and certified to British Standard EN 12566:1 Annex B.
column22: no fillers eg Chalk. Lifiting Eyes for easy installation. Feet to keep product stable during installation. Keying in lip to aid anchoring into granular/concrete surrounds. Cover & Frame as standard. Heavy Duty Shell as standard. Manufactured in the UK

column2: Shallow 2800L Euro:Septic Tank
column17: The Horizontal Septic Tank range offered by Marsh in the simplest way of treating wastewater from small developments. A Septic tank holds sewage and allows solids to settle into sludge at the bottom of the tank. Unlike a Sewage Treatment Plant the Septic tank cannot discharge directly into a watercourse so a drainage field will be required. Tested and certified to BS EN 12566:1 Annex B.
